title: Iran's navy says three tankers caught fire after hitting mines in Hormuz
detail: Iran's navy said three oil tankers caught fire on Saturday after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz: one in the eastern strait in the morning and two later in the day. This follows an IRGC Navy claim on Nov 13 that mines hit a supertanker and a second tanker. Iran said the ships had radar and positioning systems off and were on an unauthorised route. The vessels were not named and the claims are not independently verified; sources differ on the count and timing. Renewed incidents raise freight, insurance and food/fertiliser import cost risks.
